versions.content: When responding to UDS Service 0x19 with subfunction 0x05 and DTCStoredDataRecordNumber is 0x00, the Dcm shall compose the OBD Freeze- frame by looping all DcmDspPid and collecting all DcmDspPidData which are con- figured for service 0x02 by calling Dem_DcmReadDataOfOBDFreezeFrame() for the Data Element. The Dcm shall compose the DidId by adding 0xF400 to the Pid, and calculate padding and supported informations.
